# Fastmail CalDAV OAuth depends on its service-host mapping and calendar scope

The fix maps caldav.fastmail.com to the existing www.fastmail.com issuer and FASTMAIL_SCOPES.caldav, while CardDAV uses its own constant. The calendar scope already existed. DAV host entries supply strings, so getHostnameDetails returns their one service scope as both allScopes and requiredScopes; mail host entries still use the multi-service scope object. CalDavSession requests type caldav for the channel host, preserves a matching saved app-password choice and binds tokens to their origin. Host mapping is distinct from issuer endpoints or successful authentication. Static source only; no OAuth/calendar test ran.

Scope: OAuth provider hostname/service configuration.
